title: thelypteris rupestris
intro: Thelypteris rupestris, commonly known as Rock Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris rupestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
